name: Seated knee extension
description: From sitting, one knee straightens to lift the foot, then lowers. Demonstration configuration for software testing.
instructions: Sit on a stable chair side-on to the screen, with the working leg nearest the camera.
Straighten your knee to lift your foot.
Hold briefly, then lower your foot back down.

camera.guidance: Sit side-on with the working leg nearest the camera so hip, knee and ankle stay in view.

messages.target_not_reached: Straighten your knee a little further.

form_rules.message: Stay seated with your back against the chair.

setup: Use a stable chair without wheels, side-on to the screen, working leg nearest the camera.
Sit upright with your back against the chair and both feet flat on the floor.

cues.start: Foot on the floor, knee bent.
cues.move: Straighten your knee to lift your foot toward the green line.
cues.back: Lower your foot slowly back to the floor.

key_points: Move only at the knee; keep your thigh resting on the seat.
Hold the straight-leg position for the full hold time.
guidance.tempo: About 2 seconds to straighten, a short hold, then 2 seconds down.

clinical_review.note: Thresholds and dosage are illustrative values for software testing, not clinical targets.
